card.law_is_about: Tax changes including a permanent 7% VAT rate for restaurant food.
card.they_want: Uniform 7% VAT on food, including catering.
card.they_claim: Adding two standing tables automatically makes catered food subject to standard VAT.
card.the_problem: Initial counterevidence may not apply to mobile catering; a BFH ruling expressly addresses two supplied standing tables.

claim_quote.original: Dann unterliegt automatisch der ganze Umsatz dem vollen Steuersatz.
claim_quote.translation_en: Translation: Then the entire turnover is automatically subject to the full tax rate.

locator.paragraph: Paragraph beginning Die steuerlichen Vorgaben; immediately after two standing tables are supplied

request_quote.original: Sieben Prozent Mehrwertsteuer auf alle Speisen.
request_quote.translation_en: Translation: Seven percent VAT on all food.

counter_quote.original: nicht zu berücksichtigen ist daher die bloße Bereitstellung behelfsmäßiger Verzehrvorrichtungen, wie z. B. Verzehrtheken ohne Sitzgelegenheit oder Stehtische.
counter_quote.translation_en: Translation: merely providing makeshift eating facilities, such as counters without seating or standing tables, is therefore not to be taken into account.

correction: No error established. BFH XI R 6/08 treated party-service food plus two supplied standing tables as standard-rate services, distinguishing delivery and return labour from merely providing tables at a snack stand. The 2022 UStAE wording preserves the personnel-effort distinction.
effect: The proposed criticism cannot presently weaken the DEHOGA argument; source context may support its example.
limits: The 2011 ruling concerns earlier tax years and later EU/administrative rules require context, but no evidence was found that the relevant mobile-catering distinction had been displaced by November 2025. The bare-handbook counterquotation was insufficient.
materiality_explanation: Potentially minor if a misstatement were established, but source context currently supports the author. Do not count as a demonstrated error.

history.event: first recorded; original source page visually verified; pending independent AI review
Downgraded after independent AI challenge found directly relevant mobile-catering ruling; no proven error remains
Rejected after adversarial primary court evidence supports the author example; no concrete outstanding factual question

context_checked: Independent reviewer identified BFH XI R 6/08, 23 November 2011, reasons II.3(a)(aa), involving exactly two tables, and II.3(b)(bb), distinguishing delivery and return personnel effort. I independently re-read the full ruling; the original counterevidence had been read too broadly.

draft.title: Government bill Steueränderungsgesetz 2025, BT 21/1974
draft.relevant_provision: Article 4 number 2, proposed § 12(2) number 15 UStG, PDF page 11. The standing-table example describes pre-reform law in 2025, not the rate after 1 January 2026.
draft.process_status_at_screen: Completed; Bundestag passed 4 December 2025, Bundesrat 19 December 2025, published 23 December 2025.
